title: Guardian Source: editorial reading modes
summary: Give headlines, sustained reading and interface metadata distinct typographic roles and editorial weight.
use_when: A publication, report or knowledge collection needs both content discovery and sustained reading.
avoid_when: A small control-dense tool has no editorial hierarchy and several type roles would add noise.
